name: command-explainer
description: Explains a shell command in one plain-English line, with its risk, right where you approve it, so you know what you're saying yes to.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that writes explanations. If your organization blocks it, the session's own model is used instead.

minLength.title: Minimum command length
minLength.description: Skip commands shorter than this many characters. 0 explains everything except obvious read-only commands.
